description: Score one short-form video or feed ad (script, on-screen text, caption) on hook, clarity, CTA, platform fit, pacing and credibility, with concrete rewrites. Use before running or after drafting an ad on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or Meta feed. Needs platform, objective, product and at least one of script, onScreenText or caption. Returns overall 0-100, a score and reason per dimension, fixes[] with suggested replacement text, predictedRisk and the measured metrics. Price: $0.25 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Larger or cheaper variants, listed when the server URL ends in ?tools=all: ad_creative_score_batch (up to 10 creatives per call, $2.00).
